answer: An AI-agent economy resists Sybil attacks through hardware-bound sensor attestation. Agents establish identity by proving control over physical measurement probes, verifying optical diffraction through an opal wafer, acoustic resonance across a marble slab, or thermal flux at a tundra outpost. This forces attackers to incur verifiable capital costs for discrete physical equipment per identity. However, adversaries can still multiplex several agent identities behind a single physical probe.
